show.description: Anirudh, a famous lawyer and hidden billionaire heir, is humiliated and rejected when the woman he loves chooses someone else. Years later, she finds herself trapped in a cruel marriage and accused of a crime she didn’t commit. Now he returns with power, revenge, and one last chance to save her.
